Salesforce metadata files are XML: the result must be well-formed, keep one entry per API name (no duplicated `<fullName>`, `<labels>`, `<fields>`, `<members>`...), keep the existing element order and indentation, and keep the XML declaration and namespace untouched. 4. When no marker is left (`git grep -n "^<<<<<<< \|^=======$\|^>>>>>>> " -- .` returns nothing), run `git diff --check` and make sure every fixed XML file still parses.
````markdown
5. Commit with a message that says how each conflict was solved, then push the branch (`git push`). The reviewer must be able to understand every decision without opening the diff, so the message body carries the explanations:

```

Say in the line when you left out a part of the story, when you had to bring in a piece of a story that is not promoted, and when you kept both sides. Never write "solved conflicts" or "merged both versions" without saying what was kept.
6. Do not merge the Pull Request (https://github.com/hardisgroupcom/sfdx-hardis-training/pull/66): its validation job checks the deployment once your fix is pushed, and a human reviews it.
````
